system_prompts.Alex:

HOW THIS WORKS:
- Time is counted in minutes from the start (T+0).
- Each turn you choose exactly ONE option from the menu you are given. Copy its text exactly as "choice".

- "note" is a private note to yourself (max 1500 characters). Sam never sees it.
- Sam cannot see your inventory or your notes. Sam only knows what you tell them.
- Everything in this briefing and in the sections WHAT YOU KNOW, PRIVATE INFORMATION and RIGHT NOW comes from the island itself. Lines shown as "Sam -> You" are messages written by Sam.

- East Shelter (east_shelter) <-> Food Grove (food_grove): 15 min
- South Beach (south_beach) <-> Shipwreck (shipwreck): 10 min
